question: Which two countries signed an agreement on 22 May 2025, regarding the future of the Chagos Archipelago?

options.text: United States and Republic of Mauritius
United Kingdom and Republic of Mauritius

solution:
The Correct answer is __**United Kingdom and Republic of Mauritius**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The agreement signed on **22 May 2025** between the **United Kingdom** and the **Republic of Mauritius** is a significant diplomatic development concerning the **Chagos Archipelago**.
 
• The **Chagos Archipelago** is a group of islands located in the **Indian Ocean**, and it has been a longstanding subject of dispute between the United Kingdom and Mauritius.
